**Required materials:**

1. Oatley, Chapter 10 — *The International Monetary System*
2. Huang, Ying, and Maximilian Mayer. 2022. "[Digital Currencies, Monetary Sovereignty, and U.S.–China Power Competition](https://doi.org/10.1002/poi3.302)." *Policy & Internet* 14 (2): 324–347. *(PDF on Canvas)*
3. {{< fa headphones >}} [*Trade Talks* #95 — Is China a Currency Manipulator?](https://tradetalkspodcast.com/podcast/95-is-china-a-currency-manipulator/)

::: {.callout-tip}
## In class today
- Opening **writing prompt**
- The mechanics: exchange rates, the foreign-exchange market, and currency systems (fixed, floating, managed)
- The **balance of payments** and the **policy trilemma** — fixed rate, free capital, monetary autonomy: pick two
- Three monetary orders: the gold standard, Bretton Woods, and today's float
- **Student-led article presentation** (Huang & Mayer 2022)
- Podcast-based **in-class writing** (*Trade Talks* #95) and discussion
:::
